price_matrix.unpriced: {condition} has no sell-at price, so the refund cannot be sized from what you would sell at.
price_matrix.keeps: Buyer keeps paying {net}, what {condition} would sell for.
price_matrix.no_loss: Your pricing puts {condition} at or above the {paid} the buyer paid, so it sees no loss in the downgrade. Lean on the market refund or take the card back.
price_matrix.versus: {difference} versus your sell-at refund. Market has {received} at {received_price} and {sold} at {sold_price}.
price_matrix.relist: Relist the {condition} copy at this price.
price_matrix.relist_eta: Relist the {condition} copy at this price, expected to sell in {days}.
